title: My first attempt at making a game with Manus AI got a little ridiculous
author: Alexmfgseo
selftext:
I gave **Manus AI (2.0 Max)** a stupid idea and had it build a game. Whether that counts as “making a game” can be this thread’s completely reasonable, definitely civil argument.

The result: **Divorced Dad Simulator: The Final Weekend**. A 2D beat-’em-up about a tired dad trying to buy a gallon of milk without making two trips. Somehow, this nonsense now has two levels, a boss fight, and an actual ending 😂

My cousin is a gamer, so I had her try it. She genuinely loved it. Yes, my entire review department is currently one cousin. We’re a lean operation.

The mobile controls still need a few tweaks, but for my first attempt, I’m pretty happy with it. I’m not claiming I’ve reinvented gaming. I made a dad fight things over groceries.

If people enjoy it, I’d happily keep expanding it: more levels, ridiculous bosses, and increasingly unnecessary dad lore. Maybe some headline-inspired nonsense, too. Gary has grill tongs and no PR team. What could possibly go wrong?

Happy to share the link with anyone interested and post updates as it evolves.

**Play it. Roast it. Tell me what needs fixing.** I’m genuinely curious whether it’s fun—or whether my cousin is just being suspiciously supportive.
